notes.subject: Yahwe
notes.rationale: Tok i go stret long Yahwe

notes.subject: givim tenkyu
notes.rationale: אודך (ידה) em i 'pulim/thrownim hand' — tok bilong skruim long God; 'givim tenkyu' em klostu tasol

translation: Bai mi givim tenkyu long yu namel long ol manmeri, Yahwe, na bai mi playim string-singsing long yu namel long ol lain bilong olgeta kantri.

tokens.gloss: bai mi givim tenkyu long yu
na bai mi playim string-singsing long yu
namel long ol lain bilong olgeta kantri
